name: Point Location
aliases: Octree Point Location, Integer coordinate point location
Point Location — Integer coordinate point location, Octree Hashing and Point Location, Octree Point Location, Octree Point Location, Integer coordinate point location
definition: Algorithm to locate a specific node in the octree given a 3D integer coordinate (dest) and current depth/index, using precomputed child bit depths to avoid arbitrary shifts.
summary: Point Location maps a 3D coordinate to an octree leaf using precomputed bitwise masks to extract the octant index, avoiding geometric comparisons and parent pointers for fast traversal.
